name: sentinelgrc-ai
description: SentinelGRC AI — governance, risk, compliance, third-party risk and AI governance platform

scripts.db:migrate: npm run db:migrate -w services/api && npm run reference:sync -w services/api
scripts.build: npm run build -w services/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w services/api && npm run lint -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w services/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w services/api && npm run test -w apps/web
scripts.openapi: npm run build -w services/api && npm run openapi -w services/api
